value: Civil Code (Act No. 89/2012 Coll.), provisions on lease of a flat (§ 2235 and following).
source_publisher: Collection of Laws portal (Zákony pro lidi)

value: A lease of a flat requires a written form; the landlord cannot rely on invalidity for lack of form against the tenant (§ 2237).
source_publisher: Collection of Laws portal (Zákony pro lidi)

value: A cash security plus any contractual penalty may not in total exceed three times the monthly rent; at the end of the lease the landlord returns it, setting off what the tenant owes, and the tenant is entitled to interest at least at the statutory rate (§ 2254).
source_publisher: Collection of Laws portal (Zákony pro lidi)

value: The parties may agree on annual rent increases (§ 2248).
source_publisher: Collection of Laws portal (Zákony pro lidi)

value: If no increase was agreed or excluded, the landlord may propose in writing an increase up to the comparable local rent, provided that together with increases in the previous three years it does not exceed 20 percent; a proposal made before 12 months without an increase has passed is disregarded (§ 2249(1)).
source_publisher: Collection of Laws portal (Zákony pro lidi)

value: The landlord may terminate a fixed-term or open-ended lease with three months notice for gross breach by the tenant, certain criminal convictions, public-interest vacating, or a similarly serious reason (§ 2288(1)); for an open-ended lease also where the flat is needed for the landlord or close relatives (§ 2288(2)). Notice must be in writing and the notice period runs from the first day of the month after delivery; the tenant must be informed of the right to object and to court review, or the notice is invalid (§ 2286).
source_publisher: Collection of Laws portal (Zákony pro lidi)

value: For an especially serious breach, such as non-payment of rent and service costs for at least three months, the landlord may terminate without a notice period, after a prior call to remedy the conduct (§ 2291).
source_publisher: Collection of Laws portal (Zákony pro lidi)
